outcome: survival without moderate or severe neurodevelopmental disability (NDD) at 5 years
cohort: Live-born neonates between 24+0 and 26+6 weeks of gestation who received active perinatal management (i.e. birth in a tertiary-level hospital, with antenatal steroids and resuscitation at birth).
finding: A simple prediction model using gestational age, SGA status, and sex showed modest discrimination and good calibration in predicting survival without moderate or severe neurodevelopmental disability at 5 years for extremely preterm neonates.
